-- CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'Vivekbhand@2712'

-----------------------
--- CREATE CREDENTIALS
-----------------------

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL vivcreds
WITH 
     IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'


---------------------------
--- CREATE EXT DATA SOURCE
---------------------------


CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source1
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://vivdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = vivcreds
)

---------------------------
--- CREATE EXT FILE FORMAT
---------------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format
WITH(
    FORMAT_TYPE= DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
                     FIELD_TERMINATOR= ''
    )
)

---------------------------
--- OPENROWSET FUNCTION
---------------------------

SELECT 
      * 
FROM 
     OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'revenue',
        DATA_SOURCE= 'raw_ext_source1',
        FORMAT= 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW= TRUE
     ) as query1


-------------------------------
--- CREATE PARQUET FILE FORMAT
-------------------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH(
    FORMAT_TYPE= PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)
